# ops

> ops is a server-rendered product built with Go, templ, htmx 4.0, Tailwind CSS, and SQLite, with a JSON API and an MCP server for AI agents.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and primary actions.
- [Sign in](/auth): Account access.
- [Privacy](/legal/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](/legal/terms): Terms of service.
